from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter

program = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    bg = Counter(row_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_rows = [r for r, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value != bg]
    line_cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value != bg]

    intersections = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    line_color = Counter(value for row in intersections for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = {}
    for y in range(len(line_rows) - 1):
        for x in range(len(line_cols) - 1):
            patch = [intersections[y][x], intersections[y][x + 1],
                     intersections[y + 1][x], intersections[y + 1][x + 1]]
            if patch[0] != line_color and all(value == patch[0] for value in patch):
                marks[(y, x)] = patch[0]

    min_y = min(y for y, x in marks)
    max_y = max(y for y, x in marks)
    min_x = min(x for y, x in marks)
    max_x = max(x for y, x in marks)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(min_x, max_x + 1)] for _ in range(min_y, max_y + 1)]
    for (y, x), value in marks.items():
        out[y - min_y][x - min_x] = value
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    bg = Counter(row_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_rows = [r for r, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value != bg]
    line_cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value != bg]

    intersections = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    line_color = Counter(value for row in intersections for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = {}
    for y in range(len(line_rows) - 1):
        for x in range(len(line_cols) - 1):
            patch = [intersections[y][x], intersections[y][x + 1],
                     intersections[y + 1][x], intersections[y + 1][x + 1]]
            if patch[0] != line_color and all(value == patch[0] for value in patch):
                marks[(y, x)] = patch[0]

    min_y = min(y for y, x in marks)
    max_y = max(y for y, x in marks)
    min_x = min(x for y, x in marks)
    max_x = max(x for y, x in marks)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(min_x, max_x + 1)] for _ in range(min_y, max_y + 1)]
    for (y, x), value in marks.items():
        out[y - min_y][x - min_x] = value
    return out

    for c in clines:

    for r in rlines:
        for c in range(w): g[r][c] = line_color
